title: Security
subtitle: Global filter chain — toggles take effect immediately but reset on process restart.
chain.title: Filter Chain
chain.description: Enable or disable individual filters. Order matches execution priority.
filter.waf.title: Web Application Firewall
filter.waf.description: Signature-based payload inspection: SQLi, XSS, and command injection, plus operator-defined rules.
filter.bot.title: Bot fingerprinting
filter.bot.description: Per-IP scoring from User-Agent, headers, and path heuristics. Scores above the challenge threshold trigger a challenge; scores above the deny threshold return a 403.
filter.adaptive.title: Adaptive spike detection
filter.adaptive.description: Per-IP one-second window. A spike above the suspicious RPS threshold upgrades the connection to a challenge.
filter.challenge.title: Challenge ladder
filter.challenge.description: Five rungs: redirect → HTML proof → iframe → JS proof-of-work → reCAPTCHA. A successful solve mints a 24-hour fingerprint cookie.
filter.ip_acl.title: IP allow / deny
filter.ip_acl.description: Hard allow and deny lists. The cheapest filter in the chain (hash lookup) — runs before everything else.
filter.rate_limit.title: Rate limiter
filter.rate_limit.description: Per-IP and per-subnet token buckets. Per-host overrides are configured on the Rate limits page.
filter.honeypot.title: Honeypot paths
filter.honeypot.description: Bait URLs that no real user visits. Manage packs on the Honeypots page.
filter.threat_intel.title: Threat intel feeds
filter.threat_intel.description: External IP reputation feeds (Spamhaus, FireHOL, custom). CIDR-coalesced lookup.
filter.wirefilter.title: Wirefilter rules
filter.wirefilter.description: Operator-authored DSL expressions. Edit in the Config editor.
activity.title: Filter Activity
activity.description: Requests blocked or challenged by each filter (refreshes every 10 s).
persist.title: Persisting Changes
persist.description: Runtime toggles reset on restart — persist changes in the DSL config.
persist.body: The toggles above are <0>in-memory only</0> — flipping a switch changes behaviour immediately, but a process restart resets to the config defaults. To make a toggle survive a restart, edit the DSL block:
persist.note: Edit via the <0>Config editor</0> page, then run <1>{{cmd}}</1> on the server to reload without dropping connections.
